decisions.reason: Area elastic sports flooring is likely core to this specialist sports-floor maker, keeping it costs little, and with no evidence since 2019 its value remains an open option worth holding.
Event and arena demand was disrupted by COVID, so this mobile arena floor's prospects are still unresolved, and keeping the option open is cheaper than abandoning it before arena demand recovers.
This second mobile arena system overlaps with B, so consolidation is somewhat more likely, but without evidence of failure the low-cost option is kept while uncertainty persists.
Chevron parquet was featured on the home page and fits strong renovation demand, so it is a promising option with low carrying cost.
This niche squash finish costs little to keep on offer and extends the sports portfolio, so dropping it is not justified without negative results.
Oak skirting is a cheap complementary accessory to the sports floor systems, with minimal holding cost.
